correctness.rationale: Fourth-degree exact monomial moments prove Parseval on the entire nine-dimensional harmonic band. The pairwise kernel values yield three strictly excluded deletion-pair types; a counting argument proves every other 5-deletion pattern contains one. The six remaining patterns are exactly diagonalized via square Fourier modes. Independently specified direct harmonic evaluation and exact SymPy identities were executed successfully. The proof treats all 2002 masks analytically without relying on a finite numerical search.

originality.rationale: Searched several equivalent descriptions, exact tables, stronger theorems and the same geometric object. Direct complete reading of the most plausible published same-node paper showed exact-degree unweighted sampling rather than this weighted mixed-degree five-erasure optimum. The 2022 motivating article studies the full Lebedev rule; the 2017 stable minimal-dimensional design study uses latitude rings. An accessible earlier same-node rank census is logically weaker and does not imply sharp 9-sample E-optimal constants. Historical priority remains uncertain for unindexed specialist quadrature tables.

value.rationale: Nine values are the minimum for unconditional linear recovery of the nine-dimensional cumulative harmonic band, while a fixed fourteen-node degree-five positive quadrature is a natural structured pool. Sharp weighted noise-reconstruction lower spectral stability under five deletions is an intrinsic, nontrivial optimum of this existing finite frame; the equality class exhibits a structural hemisphere/pole geometry not supplied by known cubature or rank facts. The result does not pretend to optimize arbitrary floating nodes or noise covariance.
